title: Universal Tree Collapse, Complete 13-Element Green's Eggbox Structure, and Exact Cycle-Escape Laws for 1-Joined Graph Adjacency Determinants
abstract: Pinzon, Pragel, Roberts, Marshall, and Strain (arXiv:2611.34794v1) showed that adjacency determinants of 1-joined labeled path graphs are governed by a finite 2x2 integer transfer-matrix monoid M_13 under pi(G) = phi(G) E_1, leaving open in Section 6 the extension from paths to general trees. We resolve that open question completely and establish four machine-checked structural theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 proofs (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), 16 SHA-256 certificates (C01-C16), and 61 adversarial exact-integer pytest checks. First, we formalize the complete 13-element closure (169/169 products), its exact 4 idempotents {I_2, E_11, E_22, 0}, universal invariants det(pi(G)) in {0, +1} and |det(A(G))| <= 1, its 3 J-cells and 6 H-cells (Z_4, two Z_2 groups, two nilpotent cells, and Z_1), and the exact 11/13 single-path deficit missing precisely {+-E_22}. Second, we prove the Universal Tree Collapse and Surjectivity Theorem: every finite labeled tree T (|V(T)| >= 2) maps directly into M_13 (exhaustively verified across all 1,441 labeled trees on 2 <= n <= 6 vertices via Prufer codes in C09), and single labeled trees surject onto all 13 elements via minimal witnesses T_6 -> -E_22 (C10) and T_8 -> +E_22 (C11). Third, we establish the Exact Cycle-Escape Theorem: adjoining a single cycle breaks M_13 into an infinite monoid with Bareiss- and Lean-verified chain determinants det(A(1-join^k C_3)) = k + 1 (C12), det(A(1-join^k C_6)) = (-4)^k (C13), and det(A(1-join^k K_4)) = (-1)^k(2k+1) (C14). Fourth, we audit Pinzon et al.'s Section 5 chain examples via exact Bareiss elimination (C06-C08), flagging a minor path-count slip in Example 5.1 (2*2025 = 4050, not 5050).
